{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", (df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum())

# Check how many unique patients there are
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check how many rows there are
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

# Check if there are multiple sample_seq per patient
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("Max sample_seq per patient (should be 1 or 2):", df_grouped.max())

# Identify patients with multiple sample_seq
df_duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", df_duplicates['patient_id'].nunique())"}
